decision: Reject both paired IQ2 kernels and restore the retained CPU source and binary. Preserve worker-phase evidence, then remove the temporary timing code.
limitations: Caller placement differs substantially and output/draft acceptance differ. No isolated speed percentage is claimed.
Checkpoint recall is correct for this saved request; full API coverage and 128k performance remain unverified.
The source preserves standard floating-point order, but no standalone numerical equivalence test was authored.
next_source_findings: At decode, the cache remains capped at configured budget plus 2048 MiB, despite 1627 MiB free reported after this request. Runtime free memory is context dependent.
Current first-16 window cache hits were 16986/35720; the hindsight fixed-capacity estimate was 24643. This is past-window evidence, not a prediction.

Decode refresh uploads are queued after CPU expert computation and therefore add to the transition into the next layer. They can potentially be queued after cached GPU reads and before the CPU-ready wait, preserving stream order.
